notes: Runtime captures (xcrun simctl io screenshot --display=1) of a Debug build on the persistent iPhone Duo, inside apple-session run. Launched with -ScreenshotFixture -ScreenshotDate 2026-11-12T19:00:00Z -dismissedPrivateContribTip YES -ScreenshotTab board, plus -ScreenshotRecordDay 60 (your count today is 60: a record day), -ScreenshotShareRecord (taps the card's Share), -ScreenshotPerson ari-linden (your own view) and -ScreenshotHide ines-volk,odile-m,ezra-q,bram-ott,niko-vane (no rivals). Sample board data; avatars are generated identicons; nothing is fetched. No before images: Your records and the record card are new surfaces; board-no-record.png shows the Board unchanged without a record. Not captured: the open iPhone Duo (needs Xcode's device tools to unfold) and the dashed First week at #1 tile with "You're #3 this week" (on this fixture date the Sample board's seeded calendars have a week Ari led; PersonalRecordsTests covers that caption).
